question.text: Consider the efficiency of Carnot's engine is given by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>η</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>α</mi><mi>β</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mfrac><msub><mi>log</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></msub><mfrac><mrow><mi>β</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi></math> are constants. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>T</mi></math> is temperature, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi></math> is Boltzman constant, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>θ</mi></math> is angular displacement and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> has the dimensions of length. Then, choose the incorrect option.

options.text: Dimensions of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi></math> is same as that of force.
Dimensions of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>α</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mi>x</mi></math> is same as that of energy.

Dimensions of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>η</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mi>sin</mi><mi>θ</mi></math> is same as that of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mi>β</mi></math>
Dimensions of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> is same as that of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi></math>

solution.text:
Given that, η=αβsinθlogβxkT. Since expression inside the logarithm is dimensionless

βx=kT

Since the dimensions of kT are equivalent to that of energy,

β=kTx=Ex=ML2T-2L=MLT-2

Therefore, β has dimensions of force.

Since efficiency is a dimensionless ratio,

αβ=M0L0T0

⇒β=1α

Therefore, dimensions of α is not same as that of β. Hence option D is incorrect statement and the answer.

xα=βx=ML2T-2. Therefore, α-1x has dimensions of energy.
